abyss_swordsman.description: Long spectral arc; every fifth heals 2% max HP once on actual damage.

elemental_sage.description: Alternate fire splash and frost slow; every fifth adds a larger elemental burst.

sharpshooter.description: Arrows pierce up to 3 enemies; every fifth adds a three-arrow volley.

star_hunter.description: Arrows ricochet once to a different enemy; every fifth marks one 0.5s impact.

swordmaster.description: Two swift arcs per attack; every fifth adds a full-circle spin.

void_caster.description: Impacts leave 2s damage rings; every fifth adds a 2s pull zone. Armor resists pull.
